# Ethical_AI_Constraints

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The set of policy, legal, and operational rules governing autonomous weapon systems, including human-on-the-loop requirements and collateral damage minimization. These constraints shape TCC/iNEST design choices, such as adding explainability layers and safety interlocks to neuromorphic decision circuits.
